title: Trajectories of Geographic Journals: Power Geometries, Internationalisation Strategies and Alternative Epistemologies for Pluriversal Thinking
venue: Transactions of the Institute of British Geographers
why: Shows how journal hierarchies reproduce the power geometry of knowledge production, and names pluriversal alternatives. Relevant to how your own FUNGI corpus is assembled.
caveat: Written from geography. The bibliometric part depends on the indices the authors could see.
